DietPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for {PotionName.DietPotion}. Temporarily reduces the user's weight.
DietPotion_Description:
A potion that reduces the user's weight temporarily.
It doesn't change their appearance.
DisplayDollTemplate_Description: A decorative doll made to resemble a {0}.
DisplayPaintingTemplate_Description: A decorative painting made to resemble a {0}.
DontMoveCandyRecipe_Description: The recipe for a candy that stiffens your body slightly.
DontMoveCandy_Description: A candy that stiffens your body slightly.
DonutBox_Description: A box of donuts ordered by Roy.
DragonPiece'sDraft_Description: A squiggly mess of a drawing, as if someone drew it with their foot holding the pencil. It appears to be a drawing of a woman. The writings below are in the language of dragons.
DragonPiece_Description: A dragon figure made from wood. It appears clumsily made, possibly indicative of the maker's talents. Yet, you can feel the maker's love by looking at it.
DropOfEmotion_Description: A pure distillate of emotion that has solidified. It can only be found in places where hearts are strongly connected.
DryEveningPrimrose_Description:
Evening primrose that has been painstakingly sundried by Roy.
The Green Forest's gold rosemary cannot be found without evening primroses.
Dubby_Collect_Description: Unlike the soft body, the horn is very hard.
Dubby_Jelly_Description: Jelly processed from Soil Diver’s horn fragments. Excellent at absorbing impact, sometimes used for shoe soles.
EarPlugPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for the Earmuff Potion. Useful for blocking out loud noises.
EarPlugPotion_Description: Use when you need to concentrate and avoid loud noises. It's best to be cautious of accidents due to the restrictive effects on your hearing.
EarringGirlPainting_Description: A decorative painting of a cute girl.
EmptyBowl_Description: A bowl that contained food Enite cooked for Theo. The food is all gone.
EniteApplePie_Description: An apple pie made by Enite. It smells delicious.
EniteBigPie_Description: A slice of the special giant pie Enite made to celebrate the restoration of the village and welcome returning residents. Eating it fills you with happiness, and you can almost see fireworks exploding spectacularly.
EniteGrapePie_Description: A grape pie made by Enite. It smells delicious.
EniteNote_Description: A notebook describing the Cleansing Herb and the Glowpetal Bloom.
EnitePeachPie_Description: A peach pie made by Enite. It smells delicious.
EniteRainbowCake_Description:
A masterpiece Enite and the villagers made together.
 It's a chocolate cake covered in colorful cream, and it melts in your mouth.
EniteStrawberryPie_Description: A strawberry pie made by Enite. It smells delicious.
EveryBluePotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for Azure Sea Potion.
EveryBluePotion_Description: A potion created by a witch who, upon seeing the sea for the first time, fell in love with its blue hue.
ExpandPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for {PotionName.ExpandPotion}, a potion that inflates the target it contacts with.
ExpandPotion_Description:
A potion that inflates the target it contacts with.
Works better on deflated items.
ExtractorGlassBottle_Description: A circular glass bottle. It seems to be a perfect fit for the Extractor in the Witch's House.
FallenCotton_Description: Cotton soft to the touch, with tangled edges, as if it was inside something else.
FestivalInvitation_Description:
An invitation to the festival in Wisteria.
It calls even outsiders to join in the village's joy.
Fiction_Long_000_Description:
A story that came about from the shoeshiner Pietro who met a mischevious fairy.
-Writer Unknown
Fiction_Long_001_Description:
A story about two twins' treasure-hunting trip at the place where the meteor fell.
—The author is unknown
Fiction_Short_000_Description:
The epic of the hero Don Julius, who defeated the demon king.
-Helen Morgan
Fiction_Short_001_Description:
A love story about a girl named Jane, who wished to spread her wings in the sky and fly as a blue pigeon, free from all.
-Sandra Martis
FirecrackerPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for Firecracker Potion, the potion that flies high up in the sky and explodes in beautiful sparks at a specific height.
FirecrackerPotion_2Recipe_Description: The recipe for Firecracker Potion, the potion that flies high up in the sky and explodes in beautiful sparks at a specific height.
FirecrackerPotion_2_Description: A potion that flies high up in the sky and explodes in beautiful sparks at a specific height.
FirecrackerPotion_Description: A potion that flies high up in the sky and explodes in beautiful sparks at a specific height.
FirstGraduationCeremonyForm_Description: A document that lists everything needed for the first witches' graduation ceremony. Exclusive to students of the School for Witches.
Fish_Adult_Description: Instead of its meat, it's hunted more for its beautiful dorsal fin, an accessory material. Juvenile Elder Fish are called "Junior Fish."
Fish_Angel_Description: Chiefly found in static deep waters, it's a common ornamental fish due to its beautiful look. It has a strong sense of justice and enjoys helping weaker fish.
Fish_AquaTail_Description: A fish with a faint, blurry form. Though difficult to spot due to its indistinct body, it reveals its presence through the droplets and small waves scattered by its tail as it swims.
Fish_Axe_Description: A fish usually found at river mouths and in the ocean. There's an axe-like body part on its head that hardens as it ages.
Fish_BigFist_Description: Except the huge claws, all its other limbs have become less functional. Since it can't crawl fast, it has to hide between rocks, only sticking its claws out.
Fish_BigHead_Description: A fish with gorgeous stripes. Its head is big for its body, so it tilts forward when it swims.
Fish_BroomStick_Description: It has a broom-like horn on its head, and uses the horn to dig up hidden food.
Fish_Candybelle_Description: Each time it swims, its fins sway slightly, giving the illusion of a small bell ringing. Sometimes it even makes a sound itself, which some say resembles the chime of a bell.
Fish_Cantsee_Description: Usually found in static waters. Due to poor eyesight, it needs to taste food to tell what it is.
Fish_CloudSalmon_Description: A fish that keeps swimming its whole life. It's light despite the cumbersome look. The little meat on it is tasty and liked by many.
Fish_CoralCrab_Description: Common in shallow waters, it's a stunning crab that looks like coral, but it turns blue once it dies.
Fish_CrownCrab_Description: A crab with a crown-shaped head adorned with a blue crystal. Legend has it that touching its horn brings good fortune, making it popular among collectors since ancient times.
Fish_DarkMud_Description: A fish as black as seafloor mud. It can blend perfectly into darkness and avoid being spotted by naked eyes.
Fish_Deviyark_Description: Its body is faintly studded with fragments that shine like stars. Though its eyes have degenerated, it hunts by sensing the flow of water.
Fish_Doctor_Description: A docile fish that prefers warm waters. It feeds on scab over other fish's wounds, so it's usually found in crowded waters where fish fight frequently.
Fish_Driftscale_Description: A shark with little aggression that enjoys swimming underwater. It particularly likes roaming in fast currents, and it even enjoys having its nose touched.
Fish_Fat_Description: Only found in fast-flowing waters, it looks inflated because its mouth is stuffed with sand for repelling predators.
Fish_Gangs_Description: A fish found in static waters and in the ocean. Adult fish usually have wounds due to frequent fights against each other.
Fish_Gloomy_Description: Chiefly found in slow-flowing cold waters. Its taste aside, some people are unwilling to fish it due to its gloomy look.
Fish_Goldmoontail_Description: A splendid fish that swims gracefully around. Its dark navy body contrasts with its tail shining like gold, making its brilliance stand out.
Fish_Gwitch_Description: A fish wearing a witch hat. It has no magic, but always manages to scare some people.
Fish_HardLobster_Description: A crayfish usually found in murky torrents. Its untransparent body blends into the surroundings and is hard to spot. It's attracted to shiny objects.
Fish_Hello_Description: A common fish found everywhere. Highly social, it mingles with other fishes. Targeted by many fishers due to its good taste.
Fish_Ironmaw_Description: A bluish fish with a sturdy jaw. Despite its appearance, it moves slowly and feeds on shellfish.
Fish_Leaf_Description: It's hard to found because it looks like a leaf and always lies motionlessly on the surface of waters.
Fish_Leather_Description: A fish covered in hard skin that average tools can't slit. Some people even use it as a temporary replacement for rope.
Fish_Lumineon_Description: With its sleek body and long, flowing fins, it looks as if it were wearing a skirt. Its large eyes make it sensitive to light, so it is mostly active at night.
Fish_Mdefense_Description: Although delicious, it's hard to spot due to the small size, and hard to catch with bare hands due to slippery scales.
Fish_Murchin_Description: An urchin that lives in forests or mountains. Upon reaching adulthood, it goes upstream from the ocean to settle down in forests or mountains. The reason remains unknown.
Fish_Nebulune_Description: Extremely fast, it is difficult to catch sight of, but the shimmering trail left by its tail reveals where it has passed. The sight resembles a cloud of stars, which is why it is called the “Nebulune.”
Fish_NoEndure_Description: A fish that inhabits turquoise deep waters. It tastes great in water, but the taste worsens dramatically once removed from water.
Fish_Noctilux_Description: A fish that prefers fast currents. Despite its small body, it is ferocious and gluttonous, earning it the name “the brute of the deep sea.”
Fish_Nokyeomo_Description: A fish that hides among rocks in the sea. When prey approaches, it swiftly lunges out to snatch its target.
Fish_OldCat_Description: A fish with long barbels which lives in dark corners. It seems sluggish, but has a large appetite. It would launch at its prey when the latter drops its guard.
Fish_OreEel_Description: An eel with scales that shine like ore. It lives among rocky crevices, lashing its split tail to corner prey.
Fish_Piranha_Description: Chiefly found in deep waters. Aggressive but not intelligent, it would usually challenge stronger individuals before getting beaten into fleeing.
Fish_Ponglin_Description: A fish with round, swollen bumps all over its body. When pressed, they feel soft, and the lumps are so tasty that people even eat them separately.
Fish_PuffyCloud_Description: Its fins resemble clouds. Adult Cloud Fins are just like clouds when they spread their pectoral fins.
Fish_Rainbow_Description: It changes color as it swims. The color it changes into depends on its mood. Observation so far shows that it has 4 moods.
Fish_Rgb_Description: Its color changes to match the food it eats. Its color keeps changing as long as it's alive.
Fish_RockEel_Description: It gnaws a crack in the rock with teeth of steel and lives in it until death.
Fish_SalmonTuna_Description: A fish red like a pepper from head to tail. It's a glutton that won't let go once it bites.
Fish_Silks_Description: The most common ornamental fish. It has complicated patterns. The patterns usually vary significantly between individuals.
Fish_SilverLet_Description: A fish with silvery scales. Generally calm, it moves rather slowly. When predators appear, it escapes by reflecting light off its scales.
Fish_Skyfin_Description: A fish that enjoys swimming swiftly through the currents. Although fast, it often travels in schools, making it easier to catch than expected.
Fish_Sorry_Description: A fish chiefly active during daytime. Although large, it's poor at fighting, so it usually wanders in corners.
Fish_SparkleFin_Description: A fish that lives in schools in clear lakes. It leads a short but dazzling life, with a mysterious body color and a deep pink tail that together show off its radiant beauty.
Fish_Starflutter_Description: Named “Starflutter” for its resemblance to a butterfly. Active mainly during the day, it swims gracefully as its pink lines shimmer all at once.
Fish_StarlitUrchin_Description: A sea urchin that emits a sparkling light in the depths of the water. When underwater, its glow scatters like constellations, beautifully coloring the surroundings.
Fish_Stone_Description: Fishers often get confused by its stone-like appearance. Due to not being delicious, it's no more sought after than stones.
Fish_Switch_Description: A fish that resembles wearing a witch’s hat, with colors that seem to hold starlight. Known for its splendid appearance, it is said to be especially beloved by witches.
Fish_Tackle_Description: A fish found in fast-flowing deep waters. It's short-tempered and fast, so it bumps into other fishes frequently.
Fish_Transparency_Description: A transparent fish hard to see in water. In clear water, it looks like a pair of eyes floating around, while the rest of its body almost turns invisible.
Fish_VbigHead_Description: A fish with gorgeous stripes. Its head is big for its body, so it tilts forward when it swims.
Fish_Veyobeta_Description: It's so elegant when swimming that passersby would stop to watch it. Easily alerted, it hides from sight during daytime.
Fish_Violuna_Description: A fish with a purple body marked by gentle patterns that shine like moonlight. At night, the markings become even more vivid, as if the Milky Way itself were swimming.
Fish_Vurchin_Description: It lives in fast-flowing rivers beneath cliffs. Due to its large size, it has a huge appetite and rarely lives in groups larger than 10.
Fish_Vwitch_Description: A fish wearing a witch hat. It has some magic, but you can't gain the magic by eating it.
Fish_Weak_Description: Usually found in shallow waters, it's a fainthearted fish that faints or even dies when under stress.
Fish_YoungCat_Description: Chiefly found in the lower course of fast-flowing rivers. Although violent, it hardly scares any fish due to its sluggishness.
FlowerBasket_Description: A gorgeous flower basket from Roy, containing an arrangement of chamomile, Persian buttercups and white roses.
FlowerBirdFlowerTea_Description: Tea made with flowers fallen from Sprout Birds. It has an intense floral fragrance.
FlowerBird_Collect_Description: A flower that grows on the Sprout Bird’s head. It has a faint scent of spring.
FlowerBird_Powder_Description: The fine powder from the dried Birdflower. It emits a strong scent of spring.
FlowerBird_Water_Description: A liquid with a concentrated scent of spring. If it's brought close to the nose, the body will feel as if spring energy is spreading all over.
FlyingPaper_Description: Collected pages that had escaped the book and were flying about.
FogFox_Collect_Description: Sway it and it will gradually fade out. Stare at it and it will slowly reappear.
FogFox_Powder_Description: Powder made by heating the tail fur of the Fog Fox. The powder scatters and fades into transparency, making it hard to find again.
ForesightCandyRecipe_Description: The recipe for a candy that shows you fragments of the future.
ForesightCandy_Description: A candy that shows you fragments of the future.
ForgetMeNotTea_Description: Tea with the same color as the flowers. Enite made it with great care.
ForgetMeNot_Description:
Red flowers of various sizes. It's a color seldom seen in forests.
They have a faint fragrance.
FruitBigCandy_Description: A curious candy that will become the fruit flavor you like the most. Its colorfulness and gigantic size make it wildly popular, while the candy bucket can be used in many ways after it has been emptied.
FurBall_Collect_Description: It smells nice and has a unique scent. Note that pollen may make it sneeze.
FurBall_Jelly_Description: Turning it into jelly enhances its nut aroma.
FurBall_Powder_Description:
The particles are very soft, as if powder of wool.
Grinding has enhanced the floral fragrance.
FurBall_Water_Description: It smells so nice that it's often mistaken for a soft drink or tea, but it's said to taste astringent and bitter.
GagaFeather_Description: A splendidly colored feather with no known owner.
Gboolnori_Collect_Description: The stripes on its body glow in the dark.
Gboolnori_Powder_Description: Fort Rat roasted at a low temperature. Despite its alluring smell, it's highly poisonous and shouldn't be eaten as it is.
Gift_Dishware_Bottle_Kyla_Description: A bottle of sweet wine decorated with a delicate bow. Looks good as part of the decor even if you don't fancy a tipple.
Gift_Plant_RosemaryHerbaAqua_Description:
An accessory that Roy has poured his heart into making so that everyone can see the gold rosemary whenever they want.
Strangely, your heart will ache if you stare at it for too long.
Gift_SpecialRequest_BirdFlowerPot_Descri: A potted plant from Rosie. It's intentionally decorated like the one ordered by the Countess.
Gift_ThornlessRosePiece_Description:
A rose carved out of an elephant tusk. Since the stem has no thorns on it, holding it doesn't hurt.
It's very delicate though. Handle it with care.
GlassCherry_Description: A cherry whose skin is sweeter than its flesh. When the crystalline shells clink together, they create a clear, crisp sound.
GlowtwigBloom_Description: A flower that glows on its own when darkness falls. As it blooms, it is influenced by the surrounding flowers and changes its form to resemble them.
GlueCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a super strong Glue Candy that can even neatly reattach a head of a statue that was accidentally damaged.
GlueCandy_Description:
A candy possessing extremely strong adhesive properties. It can even be used to perfectly reattach pieces of a broken stone statue. A must-have for witches studying at the School for Witches.
Typically, it is melted in fire before use.
GoldRosemary_Description:
A legendary golden flower.
It lives in longing for the wilted evening primrose,
and is said to bloom near the moon.
GrandmaWisdomCandyRecipe_Description: Recipe for a candy that grants its consumer wisdom.
GrandmaWisdomCandy_Description: A candy that grants its consumer wisdom.
GreenForestPuzzleZone_Description: It’s a key for something. I remember seeing a door where I saved Rubrum...
HealingCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a candy that quickly heals light wounds.
HealingCandy_Description: A candy that quickly heals light wounds. Though it looks delicious, it has a strange taste.
HeatPotion_Description: A potion that emits warm mist from where it lands. It gently shrouds those within its reach like a streamy hot spring.
HeavyPressCandyRecipe_Description: The recipe for a candy that makes your body feel heavy.
HeavyPressCandy_Description: A candy that makes your body feel heavy.
HoneyBearDoll_Description: A doll with a broken arm. Signs of caress are all over its body. Someone must have been cherishing it for a long time.
HoneyBearDoll_Friend_Description:
A doll in blue clothes and wearing a blue bow.
The texture resembles the doll carried by Honey Bear.
HoneyBearLetterKey_Chargehand_Descriptio: A wood plaque of a unique shape. It has the faded word "foreman" on it.
HoneyBearLetterKey_Complete_Description: A wood block made by combining two wood plaques. It may fit into something.
HoneyBearLetterKey_Description: A wood plaque of a unique shape. The owner's name is on it, but is no longer recognizable.
HoneyDonut_Description: The honey adds a gentle aroma to the freshly baked donut and highlights its rich sweetness.
HoneycombPiece_Description: A honeycomb with overflowing honey. Have a bite. It's so sweet.
HookWeight_Description:
A weight with a hook allowing you to hang it someplace.
Neither too heavy nor too light, it feels just heavy enough.
IncubatorHandle_Description: Essential parts that the Incubator needs to function.
IntUpPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for the Enhance Intellect Potion. While it raises one’s intellectual abilities, one must beware of the side effects.
IntUpPotion_Description: A potion that temporarily boosts one’s intellectual abilities.
InventoryUpgradeKitTamplate_Description: A secondary bag compartment used to increase a bag's capacity by attaching it to a bag.
ItemDetectionPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for Item Detection Potion, which works as long as you know the item's exact appearance.
ItemDetectionPotion_Description: Finds the item you want as long as it's within range. Often used when looking for lost hair ties and erasers.
JingleBug_Collect_Description: It has a camouflage that prevents it from being spotted.
JingleBug_Jelly_Description: Shake it hard and it will make a noise as if whistling with a blade of grass. It's like magic.
JingleBug_Powder_Description: With its appetizing aroma and high nutritional value, it's popular among gourmets.
JingleBug_Water_Description: A liquid as clear as water. Its color appears to be different when viewed from different angles.
JumpStep_Spring_Description: A crucial part for the board to bounce.
KentLetter_WeightOfTruth_Description: A letter that also contains the materials Kent investigated for Arin.
Key_BlueTag_Description: A key with a blue tag.
Key_GreenTag_Description: A key with a green tag.
Key_WhiteTag_Description: A key with a white tag.
Key_YellowTag_Description: A key with a yellow tag.
Kirby_Collect_Description:
A bubble a Honey Piglet blows with all its might.
Filled with mushroom spores hard to collect from the wild.
Kirby_Jelly_Description: Stirring naturally creates surfacing bubbles, so the final product is also full of bubbles.
Kirby_Powder_Description:
Aromatic powder made by baking spores.
Handle it gently, since it can be blown off by the weakest flow of air.
Kirby_Water_Description:
Thick cream-colored juice.
Whenever the tiny bubbles in it burst, they let out aroma.
KylaLetter_Description: A letter meant for Kyla. It contains news of the village.
LeafOtter_Collect_Description: Hair of Leafbeaver. It has a fresh smell which feels exclusive to plants instead of animal fur.
LeafOtter_Jelly_Description: It has a fishy smell of grass and water, a weirdly harmonious aroma.
LeafOtter_Powder_Description: It has lost the fragrance of grass and only a faint fishy smell remains.
LeafOtter_Water_Description: A liquid that has a strong fragrance of grass, as well as a subtle fishy smell of water.
LetterAndPresent_Description: A letter and a gift sent to Roy, together with the hand-folded blue rose from his teacher. The box overflows with the heartfelt wishes of his teacher, the villagers, and all those connected to Roy. It's so heavy with care that it moves the heart.
LightHandsPotion_Description: Use it when you need to perform a throw that exceeds human limits.
LightStepCandyRecipe_Description: The recipe for a candy that makes you light-footed.
LightStepCandy_Description: A candy that makes you light-footed.
LisaWitchBrooch_Description: A brooch once worn by Lisa. White marble vines encircle a vivid green gem at its heart.
LisasBooks_Description: A stack of books Lisa has handed to the Society of Witches for translation. Needs to be translated before reading.
LittleMandrake_Collect_Description: A plant that takes the shape of a human. Due to the environment of the Green Forest, they cannot fully mature.
LittleMandrake_Powder_Description: Dried Little Mandrake. Rumor has it that, eating it dipped in honey is good for back pains.
Loach_Description: A cute small fish with a slight beard. It flourishes even in muddy or dirty waters.
LuckUpCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a candy that gives you a little luck.
LuckUpCandy_Description: A candy that brings a little good luck.
ManaDetectingCandyRecipe_Description: Recipe for Magic Detection Candy. Eat the candy and you'll see objects with magic glowing blue.
ManaDetectingCandy_Description: Eat it and you'll see objects with magic glowing blue. It can also be applied to objects.
MapleHerb_Collect_Description: A red herb dyed with the colors of autumn. Its rough texture feels oddly pleasant.
MapleHerb_Powder_Description: An herb that captures the rich essence of autumn. It opens with a deep, woody note of tree bark, followed by a zesty citrus finish
MapleHerb_Water_Description:
The concentrated scent of autumn fills the bowl.
It starts off with the mellow scent of tree bark, but ends with a scent of fresh citrus.
MassageCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a candy that alleviates muscle pain.
MassageCandy_Description: A candy that relieves muscle pain.
MeatDumplings_Description: A thin layer of bread stuffed with meat filling.
MemoryBookCopy_Description: A replica made by Alvin that functions just like the Book of Memories from the School for Witches.
MemoryBook_Description: A special keepsake given to the School for Witches graduates. It can store mementos of one's journey and hold the precious feelings of those the witch has met. When opened, the voices of those remembered echo vividly from its pages.
MemoryBox_Description: A securely locked box. Old and scratched.
MeteorPotion_Description:
A potion that only mimics the effect of the one used when a new witch is born.
It was a novice witch’s earnest wish that created a star.
MoneyPouch_Random_Description: You won’t know how many gold coins are inside until you open it. It can also be sold at a fair price in the shop.
Mongsiri_Collect_Description: The fur of a cute, round Squishychub. It is light and has good insulation properties. It also has a soothing fragrance.
Mongsiri_Water_Description: Placing Squishychub fur in the Witch Extractor results in a pure white, weightless extract. The extract feels more like soft powder than liquid.
MoonButterfly_Collect_Description:
The two pairs of wings on this butterfly are coated with powder that glows light blue.
The light blue glow is reminiscent of the moon.
MoonButterfly_Water_Description: A soft blue glow is coming from within the bowl. It’s just like moonlight reflecting off a river.
MoonFlower_Collect_Description: The flower of a Bitter Grape Tea Tree. It contains the power of the moon.
MoonFlower_Water_Description: Water that has a pink-ish glow, containing the power of the moon. It emits light similar to moonlight.
MoonOilRecipe_Description: The recipe of Moon Oil. It gives off bright moonlight.
MoonOil_Description: A potion that emits strong moonlight. It contains the power of the moon. It's expensive, due to the rare ingredients required to make it.
MoonTear_Description: A potion containing the effects of the moon. It’s a bit lighter than Moon Oil.
Moondelion_Collect_Description: The seeds are all gone and only the stem is left. It glows faintly.
Moondelion_Powder_Description: It's still glowing faintly. The seeds fly off easily, so be careful.
MorningSunshineTes_Description: Tea Enite made with plants in the Green Forest. The smell feels like the warm and refreshing morning sun.
Mud_Description:
Soil drenched in water.
Soft to the touch, yet it’s quite viscous.
Mud_Special_Description: Clay that glitters due to metal mixed in it. Heat and stir it to melt the metal, and it will obtain natural patterns.
MuscleUpCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a candy that temporarily boosts strength
MuscleUpCandy_Description: A candy that boosts physical strength temporarily.
MushroomWallPlants_Collect_Description: Seeds with all of a Wish Flower's nutrients. Legend says that if you make a wish and blow the seeds off, your wish will come true.
MushroomWallPlants_Jelly_Description: An even more nutritious product made by condensing the seeds.
MushroomWallPlants_Powder_Description: The originally hard seeds have become soft.
MushroomWallPlants_Water_Description: Extremely nutritious. A common dietary supplement ingredient.
NailTreeFruit_Description: A fruit with a thick, hard shell. It makes a distinct "thwack" sound when it falls from the tree. Getting hit on the head by one is incredibly painful.
Nail_Collect_Description: Faint speckles dot this dark coat. When touched, these speckles give your fingers a slightly numbing sting.
Nail_Water_Description: Hair oil used by Ground Nailer to tame its wild hair. Causes a lingering tingling sensation if it touches the skin—handle with care.
NervousDownCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a candy that relieves tension with deep breathing.
NervousDownCandy_Description: Eat it and take a deep breath. It will relieve stress.
NewPrologueChipFood_BreadLunch_Descripti:
Contents: {item/LittlePie_Lv1}, {item/CarrotDonut_Lv1}, {item/HoneycombPiece}

A lunch box that brings happy feeling with sweet bread.
NewPrologueChipFood_FruitLunch_Descripti:
Contents: {item/Cranapple}, {item/SlippyGrapefruit}, {item/GlassCherry} 2 of each

A fruit lunch box that allows you to take care of your health with fresh fruit.
NewPrologueChipFood_MeetLunch_Descriptio:
Contents: {item/Food_FatigueRandomRecovery_Lv1}, {item/BeefBread_Lv1}, {item/SloshLemon}

A hearty meat lunch box to fill your stomach to content.
NewPrologueSunlightPotionRecipe_Descript: The recipe of Sunlight Potion. It can instantly produce dazzling light containing the power of the Sun.
NewPrologueSunlightPotion_Description: This potion emits a blinding flash of light that has the power of the sun.
NoiseCandyRecipe_Description: Recipe for Quack Candy. This candy makes you quack noisily.
NoiseCandy_Description: This candy makes you quack noisily.
NonFiction_Select_000_Description:
From common mushrooms to rare mushrooms, mushrooms for snacks to mushrooms that can kill you in one day. A compendium of mushrooms.
-Mara Smith
NonFiction_Select_001_Description: A book made to practice curse application on. It's full of doodle-like gibberish.
NonFiction_SilentGuardian_Description: A history book written by Pax Silverrain. A lot of preparation is needed to decipher it due to the many magics applied.
NormalDonut_Description: A nicely baked donut filled with sweet cream.
NutritionPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for the Nutrition Potion. Temporarily gives a large amount of nutrition to plants.
NutritionPotion_Description:
A potion that temporarily supplies a large amount of nutrients to a plant.
It’s usually used as an emergency measure on dying plants.
Ondori_Collect_Description: This jelly-like shell that covered the creature's entire body has dried. It's now clear and solid.
Ondori_Powder_Description: The shell of the Jelly Shell slowly dried to become sturdier. Often reprocessed into accessory materials.
OneEyeFrog_Collect_Description: A peculiar frog with one eye. It also glows with a mysterious light.
OneEyeFrog_Powder_Description: The dried skin gives off a delicious scent. It can also be used for stews.
ParadeFlag_Description:
A flag used at the parade, with golden embroidery sewn against a claret background.

It's short of a pole, and smells faintly like paint. The patterns have faded, and the edge is slightly fraying.
Peach_Description:
Tiny thorns coat the skin of the peach.
The thorns are as soft as fur, so eating them is not an issue.
PhantomJellyfish_Jelly_Description: Jelly processed from Phantom Jellyfish, containing its faint glow. Sometimes used as a decorative material to create atmosphere.
PhillyCheesesteak_Description: A sandwich made by laying cheese all over seasoned meat.
Phoenix_Collect_Description: The feather of the immortal phoenix. It glows red, as if it is burning.
Phoenix_Powder_Description: Powder made from burning phoenix feathers. It sparkles bright red due to heat and magic.
PieceOfAdonis_Description: An Adonis Fragment crafted by Alvin. Gazing at it somehow stirs up sorrowful memories.
PieceOfBlueRose_Description:
A box filled with Rose Fragments crafted by Alvin.
Each petal is carved as if alive, just like a freshly bloomed rose.
PieceOfDaphne_Description: A Daphne Fragment crafted by Alvin. Despite being just a fragment, it emits a subtle fragrance that seems as if it will never fade.
PieceOfRosemary_Description: A Rosemary Fragment crafted by Alvin. It resembles a woman sleeping with rosemary in her arms, leaving an unforgettable impression.
PieceOfWisteria_Description: A Wisteria Fragment crafted by Alvin. Its petals hang long as if welcoming the one who gazes upon it.
PlopRadish_Collect_Description: A plant that gives off a honey-sweet smell and bears fruits with red flesh.
PlopRadish_Water_Description: The aroma of the Splash Carrot is stronger than ever after being crushed into a juice, with a thin film floating on top of the resulting liquid.
PolarisPotionRecipe_Description: A potion used for searching living creatures. It won't work if you don't know your target well.
PolarisPotionUnknown_Description: A century-old potion of unknown effect. It glows faintly in your hands.
PolarisPotion_Description: A potion used for searching living creatures. It won't work if you don't know your target well.
PolarisPotion_Materials_0_Description: In {Map.StarSeaCave}, when sunlight touches the spray of water, small bubble-like crystals are formed. They shine with a mysterious light.
PolarisPotion_Materials_1_Description: The residue left after burning midnight darkness, this ash smells slightly like dusk.
PolarisPotion_Materials_2_Description: A shiny scale that has fallen off a Starwhale. Its color changes with time and the viewing angle.
PolarisPotion_Materials_3_Description: Stardust that emits blue light. The light flickers as if caressed by a breeze.
Pompom_Collect_Description: Light and soft, yet its rachis is quite sturdy. It’s well-balanced, perfect for making a quill pen.
Pompom_Powder_Description: A dried Pompom feather. It seems to be even sturdier than before drying.
PrayerStone_Description: A mysterious stone handed down to generations of Wisteria chiefs. It's a crude rock, but there is beauty in its myriad of colors. The faint buzz of magic that it exudes hints that it might be no ordinary rock.
PrototypeDonut_2_Description: A donut made by Clala. It has the preciseness typical of Clala, but also smells sweet.
PrototypeDonut_Description: A donut made by Clala. It has the preciseness typical of Clala, but also smells sweet. It feels similar to a Munchy Donut.
PumpkinTerrier_Collect_Description:
Extremely soft yellow fur. It’s sheen is dazzling. 
It looks like material meant for luxury clothing.
PumpkinTerrier_Powder_Description:
The sheen is no longer there.
It feels like it could crumble into dust with just a touch.
QuickReflexCandyRecipe_Description: The recipe for a candy that increases your reaction speed.
QuickReflexCandy_Description: A candy that increases your reaction speed.
RainPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for {PotionName.RainPotion}. Cast it at a place to form dark clouds there and bring rain.
RainPotion_Description: Cast it at a place to form dark clouds there and bring rain.
RainbowBranch_Description:
A branch covered with spots.
Removing the paper-like white bark will reveal darker inner texture.
RainbowBranch_Special_Description: A rare branch full of vitality. The bark is very firm and hard to remove.
RainbowMud_Description:
Mushroom spores in the air combine with dust and water to form this clay.
Rich in nutrients plants need for growth.
RainbowMud_Special_Description: A glowing clay rich in organisms. Extremely nutritious and can even revive withered plants.
RainbowRock_Description:
A round white stone which fell off an egg-shaped rock.
It's smooth and comfortable to touch.
RainbowRock_Description2:
A hard stone, round and white. Spore Clay turns into it after prolonged lithification.
It's smooth and comfortable to touch.
RainbowRock_Special_Description: A stone with round ores in it, just like an egg-shaped rock. The ores are hard to process, so it's often used as it is.
RainbowRock_Special_Description2: Spore Clay containing ores lithifies to become this round stone. The ores are hard to process, so it's often used as it is.
RainbowSunlightPotionRecipe_Description: Another recipe for crafting Sunlight Potion.
RandomBox_Ritoring_Basic_Description:
You can use it to check the contents of the basket.

This basket grants a random all furniture recipe.
RandomBox_Ritoring_Basic_RecipeOnly_Desc:
You can use it to check the contents of the basket.

This basket grants a random special furniture recipe.
Raspberry_Description:
A berry that sometimes grow at branch tips. It doesn't easily fall unless it receives a huge impact.
Refreshingly sweet and slightly salty, it's a popular snack.
RattanPetal_Description: Gorgeous petals of vine flowers blooming in the temple.
RealFlowerPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for Blue Flower Potion.
RealFlowerPotion_Description: A potion that makes a flower appear vivid, as if covered with dewdrops.
Reaver_Collect_Description: An ore mushroom juice turns into after prolonged lithification.
Reaver_Jelly_Description:
Jelly made by consolidating Mole Crown.
It's as smooth as an ore and has a mysterious glisten left.
Reaver_Powder_Description:
Powder made by baking and grinding Mole Crown.
It has a faint aroma of mature mushrooms.
Reaver_Water_Description:
A liquid made by melting Mole Crown. It's slippery.
Its surface has a glittering gloss.
Reform_BroomStick_Description: A magic item that can alter the power a broom possesses. A material for customizing your broom.
Reform_Coloritem_Description: Used to change the color of items. A material for color customizing.
RememberDreamPotionRecipe_Description: A recipe for the Dream Recollection Potion. Used to recollect dreams when you awake.
RememberDreamPotion_Description: This potion allows you to remember the dreams of that night. It tastes of mashed grapes without any sweetness remaining.
ReminiscencePotionRecipe_Description: A recipe for the Reminiscence Potion. It allows you to seal items that hold precious memories within the pages of a book.
ReminiscencePotion_Description: A potion used to transfer the feelings contained in precious items or letters into a book.
RemoveRunnyNoseCandyRecipe_Description: Recipe for a candy that eases a runny nose.
RemoveRunnyNoseCandy_Description: A candy that eases a runny nose.
RewardUseItem_Fatigue_New_Description: A red gem filled with the warm energy of life. Use it, and the gem's power will seep into your body, <color=#800000>permanently increasing your maximum {Common.Energy}</color>.
RewardUseItem_Stamina_New_Description: A blue gem filled with fresh, lively energy. Use it, and the gem's power will seep into your body, <color=#800000>permanently increasing your maximum {Common.Stamina}</color>.
RitoringPouch_Blue_Description: A clover-shaped fruit wrapped in a leaf. Known as a lucky charm.
RitoringPouch_Description: A black acorn with white stripes. A thin red leaf in the shape of a ribbon rests on top. It is used as a rare ingredient.
RitoringPouch_Yellow_Description: A clover-shaped fruit wrapped in a leaf. Known as a lucky charm.
RoasterHandle_Description: A handle for a witches’ Roaster. It is of high quality, made in a fantastical place with rare ingredients.
Rock_Description:
A piece of rock that came from somewhere.
I should try not to get scratched by its sharp corners.
Rock_Special_Description: A stone block with ore in it. Process it and use it where reinforcement is needed.
Rodeo_Collect_Description:
Covered with thin and fluffy cotton-like roots.
The fruit cannot be cultivated and will not sprout even if you plant it in soil.
Rodeo_Water_Description: A juice squeezed from Buoyancy Fruit. Refreshing and fresh in aroma.
RolyPoly_Collect_Description: Unlike ordinary honey, this nectar is hard, perhaps for maintaining its shape in water.
RolyPoly_Water_Description: A pressed juice extracted from solid Duckweed Nectar. Sticky but richly sweet, sometimes used as an ingredient in special dishes.
Rosie'sLure_Description: A small carved wooden fish. It appears rustic, yet shows elaborate workmanship.
RotationAxis_Description: Looks like a rotating shaft from some machine. Old, but still usable.
RoughRyeBread_Description: It's completely black and tastes sour, but it's strangely addictive.
Roy'sBlueRose_Description: A discarded blue rose once held by Roy. Unlike the others, this one still radiates with vibrant life.
Roy'sFastGrowSeed_Description:
A fast-growing and enduring vine.
They say Wisteria's soil isn't fertile enough for it.
Rubrum'sBag_Description: A small bag made from leather. There seem to be leaves in it. It gives off a fragrant scent.
Rubrum'sGoldenApple_Description: Your wish may come true after gathering 3 of this legendary item.
RubrumHealingCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a candy that heals small wounds.
RubrumHealingCandy_Description: Small Healing Candy that can cure small wounds.
RubrumPie_Description: A small pie Rubrum made for Ellie.
RubrumToyStolenByGaga_Description: A handmade Squishychub doll of Rubrum's, taken by the Gaga Bird.
Rubrums'sMap_Description: A map drawn by Rubrum. He said he left the night light somewhere while picking baby tea leaves nearby.
SacredWater_Water_Description: Water that glows light blue. It has the hint of the scent of flowers.
SatietyCandyRecipe_Description: Recipe for a candy that makes you feel full.
SatietyCandy_Description: A candy that makes you feel full.
ScentRaisePotion_Description: A potion that enhances the scent of a target.
ScratchCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a candy that alleviates itchiness.
SeasoningPotionRecipe_Description:
The recipe of MSG Potion. 
Makes any food delicious.
SeasoningPotion_Description: This special potion can save devastating cooks that even recipes can't save. One bottle of it is enough to turn any gross dish into a treat.
SeedOfWisteria_Description:
A wisteria tree seed from Lisa.
Plant it to revive the ancient wisteria tree that shelters the village.
SewingBox_Description: A sewing kit containing worn needles and thread only enough for one more use. It can function for one last time.
SharpEarCandyRecipe_Description: The recipe for a candy that gives you a keen sense of hearing.
SharpEarCandy_Description: A candy that gives you a keen sense of hearing.
ShootingStarFlower_Collect_Description: A seed as dazzling as a shooting star.
ShootingStarFlower_Powder_Description: Powder from heating shiny Shooting Star Seeds. They look dull now, but they still glimmer when spread into the air.
SightUpCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a candy that improves eyesight.
SilverStarFlower_Collect_Description: Pollen from the Silver Starbell. It still glows softly.
SilverStarFlower_Water_Description: The melancholy sound of bells drown out other sounds each time the fluid is shaken.
SlippyGrapefruit_Description: Animals often get attracted by the smell when grapes burst and linger around. The juice is very slippery. Don't step on it.
SloshLemon_Description: Peel the transparent skin and drink the blue juice within. It tastes refreshing.
SoftGripCandyRecipe_Description: The recipe for a candy that weakens your fingers.
SoftGripCandy_Description: A candy that weakens your fingers.
SpecialSteak_Description: A steak made by roasting a giant meat cut with Arden's special seasoning added.
SpecialYarn_Description: A furball specially processed by Enite. It has a bright sheen and looks sturdy.
SpotlightPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe of Attention Potion. Often used in speeches and celebrations of the witch society.
SpotlightPotion_Description:
Drinking it gives you the temporary ability to illuminate whatever your finger is pointing at.
Often used in speeches and celebrations of the witch society.
StarBubble_Description: A single bite releases a burst of fizzy, popping bubbles. Its buoyancy allows it to float effortlessly in water.
StarJuiceRecipe_Description: The recipe for Twinkle-Twinkle Juice. Used for its light. It has the side effect of making your body glow with light should you drink it.
StarJuice_Pink_Description:
It has the side effect of making your body glow with light if you drink it.
Originally developed for mood lighting, for some reason, it’s found more use for other reasons.
StarJuice_Silver_Description:
It has the side effect of making your body glow with light if you drink it.
Originally developed for mood lighting, for some reason, it’s found more use for other reasons.
StarJuice_Yellow_Description:
It has the side effect of making your body glow with light if you drink it.
Originally developed for mood lighting, for some reason, it’s found more use for other reasons.
StarSeaCaveBranch_Description:
A branch with many twisting twigs.
It can be called artistic or creepy, depending on the viewer's perspective.
StarSeaCaveBranch_Special_Description:
A rare branch full of vitality.
The twigs are firmly intertwined, giving the whole thing a firm impression. It takes much power to break this.
StarSeaCaveLaboratoryKey_Description: A key found in the prickly vine core in {Map.StarSeaCave}. It looks crude, but is surprisingly well-crafted.
StarSeaCaveMud_Description: Clay that's soft to the touch. However, the star powder in it feels rough.
StarSeaCaveMud_Special_Description: Clay with a high content of star powder. These particles are of all sizes and emit dazzling light.
StarSeaCaveRock_Description:
A shining stone fragment that has come off of a meteor.
The surface feels warm, with a hint of magic power.
StarSeaCaveRock_Special_Description:
A piece of ore from the inside of a meteor.
It contains magic power, and pulls whoever approaches it.
StarSeaCaveSunlightPotionRecipe_Descript: Another recipe for crafting Sunlight Potion.
StickyHandsPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for {PotionName.StickyHandsPotion}. This potion can make your hands sticky to grab slippery objects with ease.
StickyHandsPotion_Description: A potion that makes your hands sticky, allowing you to handle slippery objects with ease.
StoneCrocodile_Collect_Description: Water Tail-breathing Crocs occasionally spray when breathing. They say it's a sign of gratitude.
StoneCrocodile_Jelly_Description: This jelly is filled with liquid. Shake it gently and you'll see the liquid fluctuate.
StoneCrocodile_Powder_Description: Smooth powder left after water evaporates. Don't spill it on the floor, or you will slip on it.
StoneCrocodile_Water_Description: A very sticky liquid made by further-condensing the water.
Stonepuri_Collect_Description: Stonetip flesh inside the hard shell. It's said to have a unique taste, like a mixture of carrots, sweet potatoes and potatoes.
Stonepuri_Powder_Description: Dried Stonetip flesh. The taste is a bit greasy.
Stonepuri_Water_Description: Juice extracted from Stonetip flesh. It's thick and can produce long pulls.
SunlightPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe of Sunlight Potion. It can instantly produce dazzling light containing the power of the Sun.
SunlightPotion_Description: This potion emits a blinding flash of light that has the power of the sun.
SurpriseSnake_Collect_Description: A tiny snake with an elastic body. It can bounce high.
SurpriseSnake_Jelly_Description: It's quite elastic and will bounce high if thrown at the ground.
SurpriseSnake_Powder_Description: Surprise Snake roasted until slightly browned. It's too resilient to be consumed.
SurpriseSnake_Water_Description: Rumor has it that it's a tonic, but it doesn't seem to be effective.
SweetCurseCandyRecipe_Description: A candy recipe. While the candy's effect lasts, everything you eat tastes sweet.
SweetCurseCandy_Description: While the candy's effect lasts, everything you eat tastes sweet.
SweetDreamCandyRecipe_Description: Recipe for Nice Dream Candy. You have a nice dream the night right after you eat this candy.
SweetDreamCandy_Description: You have a nice dream the night right after you eat this candy.
Tails_Collect_Description:
The wet fur from a Shroom Raccoon's tail.
It's soaked in mushroom juice and feels slippery.
Tails_Jelly_Description:
Soft jelly made by stirring until it becomes smooth.
Handle it carefully. It may bounce off if it slips out of your grip.
Tails_Powder_Description:
Tail fur totally dried and rid of juice.
The fur is glistening and looks very soft.
Tails_Water_Description: Condensed liquid from the tail fur. It has a slippery texture.
TanisStatueMap_Description: A curious map found in Tanis's sculpture workshop. It looks like an ordinary map, but shining a starry flash on it reveals Tanis's sculptures in {Map.StarSeaCave}.
TanisWitchDice_Description: Ancient witch's dice found in the {Map.StarSeaCave}. The faces are painted with a flower, a frog, a mandrake, a skull, and two wisps of flame.
TastingTicket_Description:
A tasting voucher that can be used at Clala’s bakery.
It can be exchanged for a freshly baked donut.
TeaAbility_DecreaseStaminaComsume: {0}'s {Common.Stamina} consumption reduces by {1} for a period of time.
TeaAbility_IncreaseMaxStamina: Max {Common.Stamina} increases by {0} for a period of time.
TearOfDragon_Description:
A tear of a dragon, which crystalized over the time.
It carries memories, but they are not visible to the dragon.
TemporaryMap_Description: A map showing my location at {0}. Only usable in the designated area.
Teo_Sofa_Description: A bouncy sofa custom-ordered by Theo. It's so soft and light that a gentle push may send it off in the air.
ThornPiece_Description: A piece broken off from the giant prickly vine. It is firm, but feels as if it is alive and wriggling.
ThornlessRosePiece_Description:
A rose carved out of an elephant tusk. Since the stem has no thorns on it, holding it doesn't hurt.
It's very delicate though. Handle it with care.
TickTockCandyRecipe_Description: The recipe for a candy that helps you maintain a steady tempo.
TickTockCandy_Description: A candy that helps you maintain a steady tempo.
TinkleSpider_Collect_Description: Every time it moves, it makes a jingling sound. It is still unknown how exactly it makes such sounds.
TinkleSpider_Powder_Description: There are no more sounds coming from the crispy, baked Tinkle Spider.
TinkleSpider_Water_Description:
The extract seems to make a jingling sound when shaken.
It is said to have a soothing effect on inflammations.
ToothDecayHealingCandyRecipe_Description: Recipe for a candy that treats tooth decay.
ToothDecayHealingCandy_Description: A candy for treating tooth decay.
TrainTicket_Description: Due to a strange phenomenon on the train, an item that was swapped with cheese cupcake. The person who lost it must be in panic.
Tutorial_ReformChair_Description: Aurea has tasked you with changing its color.
UncurseCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a candy that removes a weak curse.
UncurseCandy_Description: Eating the candy lifts weak curses. It is tasty and occasionally enjoyed as a snack.
UnluckCandyRecipe_Description: Recipe for a candy that brings a bit of misfortune.
UnluckCandy_Description: A candy that brings a bit of misfortune.
UnreadableMemo_Description: An old memo written in an unintelligible language. I think I learned the language a while ago, but I can’t remember.
Uru_Collect_Description:
Cotton Doggy's black fur and fluffy seeds stick together.
Maybe due to the sweet mushrooms it always eat, it has a cotton candy-like aroma.
Uru_Jelly_Description: A mild tone is added to the white base. The texture is chewier.
Uru_Powder_Description: It has a gentle and sweet aroma, as well as a bit of the smell of slightly-burnt cotton candy.
Uru_Water_Description:
Juice extracted from the sweet-smelling Cotton Doggy Fluff.
It smells like cotton candy dissolved in water.
WallSticky_Collect_Description: An orb sticky and somehow moist. It's much heavier than it appears to be, and is as hard as a horn.
WallSticky_Jelly_Description: Jelly made from Dream Orb’s marble. When stretched, it extends endlessly without breaking.
WarmComfortCandyRecipe_Description: The recipe for a candy that sends warmth across your body.
WarmComfortCandy_Description: A candy that sends warmth across your body.
WaterDragonfly_Collect_Description: It shines brightly like stars in the night sky.
WaterDragonfly_Jelly_Description: A jelly made by condensing dazzling Water Dragonflies. Do not stare directly at this blinding substance for extended periods.
WeaknessPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for Weakness Potion, which reduces the target's strength.
WeaknessPotion_Description:
A potion that loosens items firmly fixed in place.
Used to relieve body stiffness or loosen rusty screws. You can also explore other creative uses.
WeightLossPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for the Feather Potion. It lowers the weight of the target affected by the potion.
WeightLossPotion_Description: A potion that lowers the weight of a target. Its effects are weak when applied to living beings.
WhisperCandyRecipe_Description: The recipe for a candy that makes you speak more softly but be heard more clearly.
WhisperCandy_Description: A candy that makes you speak more softly but be heard more clearly.
WishPotionRecipe_Description: The recipe for a potion that carries the wish of the maker or someone else.
WishPotion_Description: A potion that carries the wish of the maker or someone else.
WishPotion_Materials_Bjorn_Description:
A material from Bjorn for crafting the Wish Potion.

It's wine and juice made from star honey.
WishPotion_Materials_Clala_Description:
A material from Clala for crafting the Wish Potion.

It's a donut coupon for Munchy Bakery.
WishPotion_Materials_Dana_Description:
A material from Dana for crafting the Wish Potion.

The glass bottle contains a song of Dana.
WishPotion_Materials_Teo_Description:
A material from Theo for crafting the Wish Potion.

It's a gaudy box.
WitchChalk_Blue_Description: Blue chalk used to draw witch sigils. It’s wrapped in crinkly paper.
WitchChalk_Green_Description: Green chalk used to draw witch sigils. It's wrapped in crinkly paper.
WitchChalk_Purple_Description: Purple chalk used to draw witch sigils. It's wrapped in crinkly paper.
WitchChalk_Red_Description: Red chalk used to draw witch sigils. It looks special, for some reason.
WitchChalk_White_Description: White chalk used to draw witch sigils. It’s wrapped in crinkly paper.
WitchChalk_Yellow_Description: Yellow chalk used to draw witch sigils. It's wrapped in crinkly paper.
WitchFairyCake_Description: A product in high demand made by the popular witch bakery “Nubicula.” Even the tacky witch hat decoration can’t stop you from savoring its delicousness.
WitchFlower_Collect_Description: A flower that gained its name as it’s used as the base ingredient for witch potions. Its tough stem can be used as a rope in an emergency.
WitchFlower_Water_Description: Extracted from the Witchflower, this fluid has a light healing property.
WitchMoneyPouch_Random_Description: You won’t know how many Luna Coins are inside until you open it. It can also be sold at a fair price in the shop.
WitchNet_Description: A bug net used by witches to catch things.
WitchPickaxe_Description: A tool used by witches to collect materials — Witch's Pickaxe.
WitchTicket_ReturnHome_Description: A one-way ticket used to get back to the Witch's House from anywhere.
WitchTrowel_Description: A tool used by witches to collect materials — Witch's Trowel.
WoodFrame_Description: A wooden picture frame that can hold a picture.
WoodStand_Description: A wooden tray table where decorations may be placed.
WorryDownCandyRecipe_Description: A recipe for a candy that relieves worries with a deep sigh.
WorryDownCandy_Description: Eat it and let out a long sigh. Your worries will go away.
YaconMelon_Description: A peculiar fruit that grows upwards from the ground. Its sweetness is something to die for. Even one will easily fill you up.
